description: This file defines API routes for managing bookings in a gym management system, including booking and canceling class and trainer sessions using FastAPI.

methods.name: book_class
methods.description: Creates a booking for a class session, handling validation and exceptions.

methods.name: cancel_class
methods.description: Cancels a class booking, with permission checks and exception handling.

methods.name: cancel_trainer
